annotation.reference_status: Listed by provider as deprecated; actual availability must be checked before paid execution. Do not silently substitute.
annotation.cost_record: Measured usage and applicable provider rate/billing record; never infer actual billed cost from a maximum-call budget.

goal_mapping.R2R_adapted: plant semantic category; requires actual asset/category adapter qualification

populations.select_rule: Use the released explicitly enumerated metadata-only reconstruction allocation. Do not select by navigation outcomes.
populations.official_test_policy: Use public development/evaluation assets only when official test labels are unavailable; declare the actual source split in the populated manifest. Never call a custom holdout the official hidden test.
populations.actual_scene_ids_status: Not recovered or allocated. Concrete counts above are configured quotas, not observed scene records.
populations.quota_change_reason: R6 minimum reconstruction:8held-out scenes exceeds4pairs; official RoboTHOR validation has15scenes and R2R-VLNCE val_unseen11, so the earlier16test-scene quota is not used.
populations.actual_allocation_status: ProcTHOR8train/2development/8test scene-goal metadata allocated, plus4separate representative replacements. RoboTHOR has4official category-goal representative episodes. R2R scenes require actual ObjectNav target qualification.

training.budget_rationale: Fixed common ceiling above the original reported Dreamer threshold counts of150k,220k,350k; not evidence of convergence or an optimal budget.
training.checkpoint_selection: Primary endpoint is the final common400k checkpoint. Development-only checkpoint choices, if used, must be separately declared; never select by test outcomes.

actor_observation.history: Dreamer recurrent state and prior actions

training.learner_hyperparameters: Original manuscript Dreamer hyperparameter table; architecture unchanged

environment_reward.distance: 3D Euclidean distance between agent and one explicitly fixed target instance; no switching among instances
environment_reward.stop_success: Explicit Stop; fixed target visible according to simulator metadata and agent-target distance<=1.0m
environment_reward.failure_stop: Terminate with ordinary step penalty/progress; no added terminal bonus
environment_reward.status: Prepared shared specification. Not the recovered historical reward and not yet fully qualified in the legacy runtime.

comparisons.geometry_control: Build adjacency from actual simulator-reachable local edges on the same sampled points. Compute hops to the same fixed target, apply identical original distance bands and sign/region reward; use true simulator visibility for the visibility branch. No VLM output.
comparisons.geometry_scope: Full semantic graph/visibility-field pipeline versus a simulator-derived geometric field under matched information types; not a label-only causal ablation.

statistics.SPL_reference: Actual navigable shortest path to the same target and success region; omit unsupported SPL, never replace with action count or straight-line heuristic.
